Dead Signal 0.3.0

A technician trapped in a biotech lab gone wrong fights his way to the top floor. Floor 1, Lockdown, Floor 2, Synthid Research, and Floor 3, Gestation, are built (packs/ds-*); The Dead Signal Laboratory, The Complex and The Sterile Annex follow them as placeholders. games/dead-signal/DESIGN.md has the plan.

To play, open index.html in a browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari). It needs a keyboard and mouse.
Made with the Linear Maze engine (engine/). The game itself is in games/dead-signal/.
